product: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m SIN Grid
quality_policy: MOD13Q1 VI_Quality: VI quality bits 0-1 == 0; VI usefulness bits 2-5 <= 8; adjacent-cloud bit 8 == 0; mixed-cloud bit 10 == 0; land/water bits 11-13 == 1; possible-snow bit 14 == 0; possible-shadow bit 15 == 0. NDVI/EVI valid DN range -2000..10000, fill -3000, scale factor 0.0001. Project usability threshold: >=10 good pixels and good/candidate fraction >=0.20.
aggregation: 199 original ADM2 polygons; union used only for country clip
